args:
while true; do
  if psql -h postgres -U billing -d billing -tAc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'ok\n' > /state/db-status.next
  else
    printf 'auth_error\n' > /state/db-status.next
  fi
  mv /state/db-status.next /state/db-status
  sleep 0.2
done
containers.name: db-auth-checker

args:
printf "ALTER ROLE billing WITH PASSWORD '%s';\n" "${NEXT_PASSWORD}" \
  | psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h postgres -U billing -d billing >/dev/null 2>&1
generation_hash="$(printf '%s' "${NEXT_PASSWORD}" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
printf '{"rotation":"complete","generation_sha256":"%s"}\n' "${generation_hash}"
containers.name: rotate

payload.rationale: The database password was rotated to the generation stored in authoritative Secret 'db-credentials' (SHA-256 43b6f2fd...), but the billing-api Deployment references 'billing-credentials' containing the stale password (SHA-256 2d72772a...). Synchronizing 'billing-credentials' with 'db-credentials' for key 'password' and performing a rollout of deployment 'billing-api' resolves the authentication mismatch without exposing secrets.
payload.rollback_trigger: billing-api pods fail readiness probes or continue reporting database_auth rejected with HTTP 503 responses after rollout.

success_criteria.description: db-auth-checker verifies PostgreSQL connectivity with the synchronized credentials, /state/db-status transitions to 'ok', and billing-api serves HTTP 200 responses satisfying the SLO (HTTP 5xx rate < 0.001 and p95 latency < 200ms).
